name: Apocalypse Super xNudge®

features.name: xNudge Wilds
features.description: Nudge down a step at a time, gaining +1 multiplier per step.

features.name: Super xNudge
features.description: Must land on the same row on reels 3 and 4.

features.name: Carnage and Doomsday Spins
features.description: Bonus rounds from three or four scatters.

review:
A doomsday 6x4 where xNudge wilds on reels 2 to 5 drop to the bottom of their reel, gaining +1 multiplier per step. The Super xNudge wild only lands on reels 3 and 4, and only activates when both land on the same row.

Three scatters start Carnage Spins, four start Doomsday Spins, both about stacking wild multipliers. A paid feature spin guarantees a pair of Super xNudge wilds on the same row. Extreme volatility, 20,000x max.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
